semantic_review_conclusion: All targeted narrative hits concern Personal Context tool availability, authorized input lookup scope, or the prior disclosure review; no retrieved unrelated personal facts are present. Public repository author/actor metadata remain provenance, not a raw Personal Context response.
limitations: Review covers only the 209-file snapshot captured at the stated times. Later reports 97–100 and final publication metadata are outside this snapshot.
Credential patterns and targeted semantic inspection are bounded content checks, not proof that every conceivable encoded secret is absent.
Archive records were inspected as inert data; this review did not repeat provider authentication, replay, governance tests or native execution.
Static fixture reconstruction used only literal AST data and a bounded subset of literal operations; no imported project function or retained code was run.
